findings.title: Deprecated iterator API should be removed, not warned
findings.body: The iterator API (`useStore[Symbol.iterator]`) is deprecated and slated for removal in v4. Keeping it with a console.warn inside the implementation is inconsistent with the goal of extracting React-specific code into its own file. Remove the entire block to align with the refactor intent and avoid future maintenance burden.
